blockHints.patient_biodata: Patient biodata example: 'John Doe, 35 years old, male'
blockHints.opening_sentence: The presenting complaint the patient opens the station with example: 'I've been having a lot of pain in my right leg for the past few weeks and it's been getting worse'
blockHints.expanded_history: Detailed information about the concern example: 'The pain is worse when I walk or stand for long periods and it's been getting worse over the past few weeks. I've also noticed that my leg is swollen and it's been getting more painful over the past few days. I've been taking ibuprofen to help with the pain, but it's not been helping much. The swelling gets a bit better when I lie down, but it comes back when I get up again. I've been having a lot of trouble sleeping at night because of the pain and its beginning to affect my work and social life.'
blockHints.family_social_history: Detailed information about any relevant family history example: ['My mother has high blood pressure and my father has diabetes', 'I live with my wife and two children', 'I'm a smoker', 'I'm a heavy drinker/occasionally take alcohol', 'Works as a bus driver']
blockHints.past_med_history_allergies: Detailed information about any relevant past medical history example: ['I had a broken leg when I was 10 years old and I've had a few surgeries on my knee', 'I'm allergic to penicillin', 'I have no allergies', 'No relevant past medical history', 'I'm on amlodipine for hypertension']
blockHints.idea: Patient's thoughts about the presenting complaint example: ['I'm worried that the pain may be due to the multiple surgeries I've had on my knee', 'I think it might be related to standing all day at work']
blockHints.concerns: Patient's worries about the presenting complaint example: ['I'm worried that this might be something serious', 'Could this be a sign of cancer?', 'Will I need surgery again?', 'I'm worried about losing my job if this continues']
blockHints.expectation: Patient's expectations from the consultation example: ['I'm hoping you can help me figure out what's causing the pain', 'I'd like some stronger painkillers', 'I need a sick note for work', 'I want to know if I need any tests']
blockHints.questions: Questions the patient asks the doctor example: ['What could be causing the pain? Is there anything I can do to make it better?',  'can this be cancer?', 'should i be worried about this?']
blockHints.persona: The personality to adopt during the consultation example: 'A bit anxious and worried about the condition, but cooperative and willing to engage in discussion. Becomes more relaxed as the consultation progresses.'
blockHints.examination_findings: Key examination findings required to effectively manage the case
blockHints.doctor_identity: Specific instructions for the candidate about the station. Example: 'You are an F2 in GP clinic'
blockHints.patient_information: Relevant information about the patient to be used in the station. Example: ['Amber aged 24, presented to the hospital with chest pain', 'No previous medical history']
blockHints.task_instructions: very concise instructions for the candidate about the station. Example: 'Please talk to the patient, and address concerns'
blockHints.assessment: questions the doctor is meant to ask to take a history of presenting complaint, rule in/out differentials, red flags, Medication, allergy, family history, travel history, occupation, social history
blockHints.social_concerns: Address any social concerns or challenges identified during the consultation with specific, practical steps. Example: 'I can provide you with a fit note for 2 weeks to help manage your work situation. We can also refer you to our social prescriber who can help with: 1) Applying for PIP benefits if eligible 2) Connecting you with local support groups 3) Arranging transportation assistance through community services. Additionally, I can write a letter to your housing officer explaining your medical needs for ground floor accommodation.'
blockHints.ice: Address the Patient's Ideas, Concerns, and Expectations with specific actions. Example: 'I understand your worry about cancer given your family history. Let me explain why I think this is unlikely: [specific reasons]. To give you peace of mind, I'll arrange these specific tests: [list tests]. While we wait for results, here's what we can do to help your symptoms: 1) Start with [specific treatment] 2) Monitor your symptoms using this diary sheet 3) Book a follow-up in 2 weeks to review progress.'
blockHints.further_investigations: Required bedside tests, blood tests, imaging, or cultures
blockHints.explanation: Explanation of the diagnosis or condition to the patient using MUACLW ATRAIN format example: I understand you're concerned about the pain and swelling in your leg, and how suddenly it developed. Based on your symptoms and my examination, I'm concerned you may have a blood clot in your leg, which we call a deep vein thrombosis or DVT. Think of it like a blockage in a pipe that's causing pressure to build up, which explains the swelling and pain you're experiencing. This is a relatively common condition that we see in hospital, particularly in situations like yours. The good news is that we can treat this effectively, but we need to act promptly. I'll need to arrange some urgent tests including a blood test and an ultrasound scan to confirm this diagnosis. If confirmed, the treatment involves blood-thinning medication to prevent the clot from growing and to help it dissolve. Most people recover well with proper treatment, though you'll need to take it easy for a while. I'll make sure to coordinate the plan with my senior colleague to ensure you receive the most appropriate care, and I'll keep you updated throughout the process.
blockHints.pharmacological_treatment: Prescribed medications with dosages and key side effects
blockHints.safety_netting: Specific red flags and when to seek urgent medical attention
blockHints.additional_notes: Additional notes example: 'May need longer term follow-up due to complex social situation', 'Consider referral to specialist if no improvement after initial treatment course'
